scope: Independent read-only review of the unexpected package02 executable delta and whether a postbuild-only integrity amendment is lawful. This review does not approve an adapter implementation, relabel the retained postbuild failure, authorize a rebuild, or authorize native execution.

findings.finding: The two equal-length executables differ in 62 bytes, and every differing byte lies within the full 64-character integrity value at offsets 221668783 through 221668846. The diagnosis additionally parses the surrounding 122-byte PE INTEGRITY/ELECTRONASAR resource, proves 51 of 52 PE resources byte-identical, and proves replacing only the old complete integrity value yields the candidate executable byte-for-byte.

The independently recomputed ASAR-header SHA-256 values from installed app-builder-lib 25.1.8 exactly equal the respective embedded PE values. The ASAR inventories have identical 14,818-entry topology and 12,252 of 12,253 file bytes identical; the sole changed ASAR file is reviewed src/desktop/electron-main.cjs at the candidate source hash.

Both packages contain the same 1,228 relative paths, with 1,225 byte-identical files. The exact three changed paths are the executable, resources/app.asar, and resources/dist/desktop/desktop_sim.cjs. The packaged desktop bundle equals the local reviewed build, its source map embeds reviewed desktop_sim.ts exactly, and all enumerated UI, media, terrain, and remaining package files are unchanged.

The original postbuild correctly rejected a third path outside its two-path assumption. That failure remains truthful. The new evidence revises the assumption by proving the executable is a deterministic derivative of the authorized ASAR header; it does not waive or overwrite the failure.

minimumAcceptableAdapter: Remain in an excluded new subdirectory and leave the frozen v2 config, validator, packages, successful build receipt, and failed postbuild receipt unchanged.
Consume the exact v2 config and original successful build receipt/result and revalidate the clean exact candidate and fixed authority before reading package outputs.
Require the exact 1,228-path inventory, 1,225 byte-identical files, and exactly the three measured changed paths.
Require the exact ASAR topology and only reviewed electron-main.cjs changed; require the candidate desktop bundle equal the local bundle and the source map equal reviewed desktop_sim.ts.

Recompute both ASAR-header hashes with the installed builder algorithm, parse both PE resource tables, require 51 of 52 resources identical and only INTEGRITY/ELECTRONASAR changed, and require full executable equality after replacing only the old 64-byte value.

Emit EXE_INTEGRITY_PROOF.json plus the existing awwv.cold-load-validation.package-binding.v2 shape. Keep the downstream consumer receipt allowlist at the single PACKAGE_BINDING.json artifact by running this adapter under an explicit two-artifact postbuild receipt and passing its package binding artifact to the unchanged consumers.
Prove the frozen adapter and its negative controls in a separate targeted independent review before actual execution.

limits: No source, package, executable, build receipt, failed receipt, gameplay artifact, or tracked file was changed by this review.
No rebuild, cold consumer, engine, native process, campaign, or suite was run.
Actual package acceptance and native authorization remain pending.
